review_kind: Independent bounded final archive/metadata/link-resolution evidence audit

required_before_commit: Execute reviewed checkpoint.py against unchanged endpoints/approved artifact map.
Verify generated records/checkpoint.json plus existing records/evidence.tar.xz and records/evidence-index.json are present.
Include all three referenced records in the same commit.
accepted_resolution_gate.not_claimed: Current checkpoint existence, observed staging/commit, provider rejection or a zero-finding provider result.

producer_scope.seal.py: Read-only terminal receipt/certificate/source/provider guards and scoped immutable archive construction; not executed.
producer_scope.checkpoint.py: Read-only exact approval/endpoint/absolute-artifact/source/prepared gate, pending checkpoint write and all-three-record nonempty checks; not executed.
producer_scope.promote.py: Read-only local exact-base/one-child/sole-parent clean preflights, local fetch and ff-only, bounded fresh prepare, full tracked/prepared identity and terminal/failure receipt flow; not executed.

limitations: Prior cycle and performance raw numerical audits remain separate certificates; final metadata review does not broaden their conclusions.
Observed sampled physical footprint/IOSurface band and tracked cleanup do not prove full native/GPU allocator reclamation, zero growth, unsampled peaks or P11.
RSS growth is retained; both ordinary renderer populations fail unchanged latency targets. Sequential campaigns under background load do not prove a controlled mode/historical speedup.
Separate GPU route observations do not count physical transfer/completion or broader scene eligibility and remain excluded from ordinary timings.
Selected runtime/source/prepared identities are not complete compiler/module-cache/SDK/static-native closure.
Human input/VoiceOver, cross-display, broader services, GPU-loss policy, sustained targets, full P11, distribution/release and full Mac completion remain open.
All-three-record commit inclusion and generated checkpoint existence are required subsequent gates, not observations made by this read/hash-only reviewer.
